chapter: This Is Your Life and film work
title: Dave Dexter and Alan Prade on the show
summary: Dexter and Southern Rhythm Boys manager Alan Prade were brought on, and Prade recalled her father's summer troupe.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And I just -- you know, even today, I haven't seen this in a long time, but when I see it now I sort of get a little drippy eyed.
Oh, sure. Were there any musical people also brought on to it?

Well, Dave Dexter, of course, that was instrumental in getting me on records. And one other person was brought on, was very comical, was a guy named Alan Prade, who I think I mentioned earlier. He was at one time the head of the -- he was the manager of the Southern Rhythm Boys Band that I played in before I came to California. He was also at one time, he had a band called Alan Prade's Syncopators, or something like that.

But nevertheless, he was brought out for this. He was living down south, in Port Arthur, Texas or somewhere, and he was a huge man. He weighed about 350 pounds, I guess, or close to 400 if anything. And they brought him out and he told some of the experiences, you know, how my dad used to take us around. I told this earlier too, how he used to take us around in the summer and we used to play little shows and little concerts at the various schools, you know, in the little towns of Texas and Louisiana.
